title: Topological Horseshoe Induced by Periodic Switching Between Non-Isochronous Planar Systems
summary: We establish a criterion for the existence of a topological horseshoe in a class of planar systems generated by periodic switching between two subsystems, each admitting a family of closed orbits, where the mechanism for chaos arises from the non-isochronicity of each subsystem.
